machine_bound: runtime_cpus is Go runtime.NumCPU() on the producing host (macOS CTL_HW/HW_NCPU). The corpus is only valid on a host with the same logical CPU count.
corpus_provenance: GENERATED by real Go execution of main.go driving rtc.BroadcastDataPacketForRoom against the pinned tree. Producer is NEWLY AUTHORED. Every key the Rust consumer reads reproduced exactly on a second run; only the extra arrival_order key varies with goroutine scheduling.
scope: Admission-scheduling component proof, not wire proof. The real rtc.BroadcastDataPacketForRoom runs unchanged (single shared proto.Marshal, dataForwardLoadBalanceThreshold=4, utils.ParallelExec, runtime.NumCPU clamp) and wire_hex is real pinned-protocol proto.Marshal output, but the recipients are pinned upstream typesfakes.FakeLocalParticipant and the room inventory is typesfakes.FakeRoom. NOT proven: real ParticipantImpl.SendDataMessage queueing, real ICE/DTLS/SCTP datachannel delivery, encryption, Room.onDataMessage upstream of the broadcast helper (duplicate-nonce and destination filtering are exercised only through the fake room's IsDataMessageUserPacketDuplicate=false), and cross-host CPU counts. maximum_active is measured by parking every recipient stub and observing the concurrency peak, so it reflects workers actually spawned on this host.
